title.zh: 【SBI 控股与 Cross River 母公司达成合作，拟在日本设立合资公司并投资入股】
title.en: 【SBI 控股与 Cross River 母公司达成合作，拟在日本设立合资公司并投资入股】

current_state.zh: SBI Holdings signed an MOU with CRB Group, Cross River Bank's parent, to form a Japanese joint venture for RWA tokenization, cross-border payments and AI-agent payment infrastructure, take a strategic stake in CRB, and connect the trust-based JPYSC yen stablecoin to Cross River's platform.
current_state.en: SBI Holdings signed an MOU with CRB Group, Cross River Bank's parent, to form a Japanese joint venture for RWA tokenization, cross-border payments and AI-agent payment infrastructure, take a strategic stake in CRB, and connect the trust-based JPYSC yen stablecoin to Cross River's platform.
